standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: The plain leaf, cream casing and attached lever retain softly eased edges.

rear.note: The opposite face and lever remain complete inside the same casing.

detail.note: Restrained painted surface and a small connected lever improve the simple original door.

underside.note: The leaf and jamb bottoms remain closed with a clear opening threshold.

clay.note: The flush-door construction remains recognizable without decorative panels or material color.

front.note: Two glazed leaves retain separate crossbars, cream frames and paired handles.

rear.note: The reverse face preserves the original pane divisions and frame connections.

detail.note: Clear glazing and narrow eased bars remain distinct; the center handles are attached.

underside.note: Both leaves and the full casing remain aligned at the lower edge.

clay.note: The eight-pane arrangement remains readable without glass coloration; motion is not judged from still views.

front.note: The two glazed panels retain slim frames, tall pulls and a timber-colored outer track.

rear.note: Rear view preserves the overlapping panel arrangement and both pull silhouettes.

detail.note: Glass edges, pull standoffs and frame junctions remain clear with restrained surface detail.

underside.note: The lower track and two panel bottoms remain continuous and aligned.

clay.note: The two-panel construction remains legible in clay; static views do not claim sliding-runtime proof.

front.note: Three distinct glazed leaves retain the original sliding-panel layout and tall pulls.

rear.note: The rear view keeps the same three aligned frames within the fixed casing.

detail.note: Slender handles and clear glazing remain distinct under the refined finish.

underside.note: The continuous bottom track remains attached to all three framed leaves.

clay.note: The three-panel construction remains readable without materials; the original dynamic contract remains separately validated.

front.note: The plain pocket leaf and narrow recessed pull retain a clean framed silhouette.

rear.note: The rear face remains complete inside its unchanged casing.

detail.note: The recessed pull and softly finished paint remain legible against the plain leaf.

underside.note: Jamb bottoms and the closed leaf edge remain aligned.

clay.note: The simple pocket-door construction remains clear; motion is not inferred from these stills.

front.note: The paired paneled fronts and recessed pulls retain a coherent double-door layout.

rear.note: The original plain backs remain complete and aligned in the same outer track.

detail.note: Panel relief, center gap and both inset pulls stay distinct with softened edge response.

underside.note: The bottom frame and separate leaves remain closed and aligned.

clay.note: Raised front panel construction remains readable; plain rear faces are an inherited design limitation.

front.note: Two raised panels and an inset pull preserve the narrow Shaker pocket-door character.

rear.note: The original plain rear leaf and casing remain complete.

detail.note: Panel borders and the small recessed pull remain visible without excessive beveling.

underside.note: Leaf and track edges remain aligned along the lower opening.

clay.note: The two-panel front remains legible in clay; the unchanged plain rear is acknowledged.

front.note: Two framed panels, cream casing and a small lever retain clear construction.

rear.note: The reverse face preserves the same panel divisions and attached handle.

detail.note: Panel borders and restrained paint highlights improve the simple original leaf.

underside.note: The leaf and casing remain complete and aligned below.

clay.note: Two-panel relief survives without material color and no unsupported trim is visible.

front.note: Six separate panels remain clear inside the narrow door casing.

rear.note: The opposite side preserves the same panel pattern and lever placement.

detail.note: Panel junctions, the small lever and soft edge highlights remain distinct.

underside.note: The bottom panels and jambs remain closed without gaps introduced by refinement.

clay.note: The six-panel arrangement remains readable in the uncolored view.

front.note: The narrow two-panel leaf retains fine frame edges and its small central handle.

rear.note: The rear face and slim casing remain intact with no silhouette regression.

detail.note: Raised panel borders remain readable; this is intentionally a simple painted door.

underside.note: The lower leaf edge and narrow jambs remain complete.

clay.note: The slim proportions and two-panel relief remain clear without color.

front.note: Two genuinely recessed bowls remain clearly separated above the fitted drawer cabinet.

rear.note: The closed timber-colored rear and four small feet remain aligned.

detail.note: The bowl lips, taps and brass pulls remain legible; the inherited inner basin profile is visibly chamfered rather than smoothly sculpted.

underside.note: The cabinet bottom and four supports remain closed and connected.

clay.note: Both recesses and the four-drawer layout remain clear in clay; refinement is restrained and the basin profile remains stylized.

front.note: The tall paired-front closet retains six panel divisions and narrow dark pulls.

rear.note: The closed rear and original small fitting remain complete.

detail.note: Panel gaps and eased case edges read clearly against the blue-grey finish.

underside.note: The dark recessed plinth supports the closed case bottom.

clay.note: The tall divided-front construction remains clear without material color.

front.note: Two opal globes hang separately beneath the thin brass bridge and ceiling plate.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves both suspensions and balanced globe spacing.

detail.note: Full detail shows sufficiently rounded opal globes and attached fine cables; faint inherited latitude shading remains.

underside.note: Both globe bottoms are complete and the ceiling fitting remains connected.

clay.note: The paired globes and fine suspension structure remain readable without emission.

front.note: Two fitted fronts and long dark pulls retain a compact layered cabinet silhouette.

rear.note: The complete rear panel and small original fitting remain intact.

detail.note: Drawer gaps, eased top edges and narrow pulls stay readable.

underside.note: The closed base sits on its original recessed dark plinth.

clay.note: The two-drawer case remains coherent without color; the finish remains intentionally plain.

front.note: The rounded dock, dark parking recess and separate robot retain clear appliance construction.

rear.note: The closed rear case and projecting base remain aligned.

detail.note: The small top controls, gold reveal and robot sensor retain readable separation.

underside.note: The base is closed and the robot remains seated at the dock opening.

clay.note: The cabinet, recess and low robot silhouette remain distinct without materials.

front.note: Four fitted fronts and narrow dark pulls preserve the broad dresser layout.

rear.note: The full rear panel and small original fitting remain complete.

detail.note: Clean drawer gaps and softly finished case edges improve the original plain cabinet.

underside.note: The closed bottom and recessed plinth remain attached across the case.

clay.note: The four-drawer layout is clear without color or surface texture.

front.note: The raised mirror lid and open divided organizer retain a distinct dressing-table construction.

rear.note: Rear view preserves the mirror backing, four legs and small drawer.

detail.note: Separate organizer bays, mirror frame and fitted drawer remain clear with eased timber edges.

underside.note: The divided tray bottoms and table frame are closed and supported.

clay.note: The open mirror compartment and four-legged frame remain legible in clay.

front.note: The fluted pedestal is clear, but the broad circular tabletop has obvious polygonal silhouette steps.

rear.note: The opposite view repeats the coarse radial edge around the top and weighted foot.

detail.note: Full detail shows straight segments around the tabletop and base despite the rounded shading; denser measured radial profiles are needed.

underside.note: The foot and underside are closed and connected; no missing structural part is implied.

clay.note: The circular edge faceting remains visible without materials and is not solved by the surface refinement.

front.note: The round padded seat retains its adjustable center post and three connected legs.

rear.note: The tripod spacing and closed seat remain consistent from behind.

detail.note: Thread-like post rings, central collar and rounded metal struts remain legible.

underside.note: The closed seat pan and all three rubber feet remain attached.

clay.note: The adjustable stool construction remains readable without color; the cushion is intentionally simple.

front.note: The appliance is recognizable, but its large door rim and dark glass have visibly uneven polygonal edges.

rear.note: The closed rear housing remains sound and should be retained.

detail.note: Full detail confirms coarse irregular door and dial silhouettes plus straight gasket lines crossing outside the circular door.

underside.note: The case bottom and original door assembly remain complete; repair should target circular profiles and the incorrectly shaped gasket.

clay.note: The large polygonal door remains conspicuous in clay despite improved case surfaces.

front.note: Two telescopic legs and a clean white top retain the standing-desk construction.

rear.note: The rear crossbar and paired foot rails remain connected.

detail.note: The cable ports, small control pad and nested leg sections stay readable.

underside.note: The support frame joins both leg columns beneath the closed tabletop.

clay.note: The nested columns and broad foot rails remain clear without materials.

front.note: The dark hopper and two separate metal bowls retain clear automatic-feeder construction.

rear.note: The rear case and projecting bowls remain aligned and complete.

detail.note: Raised bowl rims, small display and front outlet remain legible under subdued metal response.

underside.note: Both bowls have closed bottoms and the hopper base remains complete.

clay.note: The two recessed bowl shapes and tall dispenser remain distinct in clay.

front.note: The two recessed receptacle faces remain distinct inside the softly edged wall plate.

rear.note: The original dark back plate remains closed and aligned.

detail.note: The paired slots, round ground openings and small central fixing remain clearly modeled.

underside.note: The plate thickness and projecting receptacle faces remain complete below.

clay.note: Socket recesses remain visible without color; this is a visual fixture, not a wiring validation.

front.note: The layered woofer, rectangular tweeter and timber side cheeks retain a coherent speaker silhouette.

rear.note: The closed rear and round original port remain intact.

detail.note: Full detail preserves the tweeter grille, small corner screws and concentric woofer layers with restrained surface response.

underside.note: The base is closed and all original small feet remain present.

clay.note: Layered driver geometry remains legible without materials; the plain timber cheek finish is inherited.

front.note: The kettle retains its controls, but the pouring spout ends in a solid flat cap and the circular body is visibly faceted.

rear.note: The timber handle and closed base remain attached; these should survive the correction.

detail.note: Full detail confirms the blocked blunt spout, polygonal lid and misplaced tiny grip ribs around the vertical knob.

underside.note: The base is closed and the level scale remains intact; a bounded hollow outlet and smoother turned profiles are needed.

clay.note: The capped spout and coarse circular silhouette remain clear in clay, so texture refinement alone is insufficient.

front.note: Separate drum pads, cymbals and the small control module retain a recognizable electronic kit.

rear.note: The rear frame and pedal arrangement remain complete and connected.

detail.note: Individual pad rims, cymbal centers and pedal ribs stay legible with restrained metal response.

underside.note: Pad backs, rack supports and rubber feet remain attached below.

clay.note: The pad arrangement and supporting rack remain readable without color.

front.note: The original stylized figure retains its hair, costume divisions and separate display base.

rear.note: Rear hair sections, costume pieces and long accessories remain intact.

detail.note: Facial marks, buttons and layered outfit details are preserved; this remains the authored low-poly figurine, not a newly realistic character.

underside.note: Feet and accessories remain seated on the closed round base.

clay.note: The figure and accessory silhouettes remain legible without material color.

front.note: The narrow top, lower shelf and four timber legs retain a clean open console silhouette.

rear.note: The rear apron and shelf joints remain complete.

detail.note: Eased slab edges and connected leg joints improve the otherwise plain timber construction.

underside.note: Both shelf bottoms and the supporting aprons remain closed and connected.

clay.note: The open two-level construction remains clear without materials.

front.note: The real open mesh back and seat remain distinct inside the chair frame.

rear.note: Lumbar support, rear frame and five-spoke base remain attached.

detail.note: Fine mesh openings, arm pads and the lumbar bolster stay legible at close range.

underside.note: The seat pan, center post and five small castors remain connected.

clay.note: The open mesh and articulated-looking frame remain readable without color; no ergonomic performance claim is implied.

front.note: The control bridge, brewing head and recessed tray retain a clear compact espresso-machine layout.

rear.note: The closed boiler housing remains complete and aligned with the base.

detail.note: Gauge, display, portafilter handle and steam wand remain separate and legible.

underside.note: Full underside confirms the group head, tray clearance and steam wand; the small outlet detail remains simplified.

clay.note: The bridge, brewing recess and raised drip tray remain clear without materials.

front.note: The left chaise and two-seat section retain connected warm upholstery with clean restrained surface grain.

rear.note: Rear cushion backs and low rails remain supported above the closed platform.

detail.note: Cushion boxing and broad soft-arm caps retain subtle rounded highlights without coarse weave.

underside.note: Both closed base modules and the original short feet remain aligned.

clay.note: The left-chaise construction remains clear in clay; the cushions preserve the original fairly tailored silhouette.

front.note: The right-chaise layout retains connected matte upholstery and its separate seat pads.

rear.note: Rear rails and cushion backs remain complete without a new unsupported gap.

detail.note: Soft arm edging, cushion seams and restrained cloth response remain clear.

underside.note: The two closed platform sections and short timber feet remain attached.

clay.note: The right-chaise configuration remains readable without color while preserving the original tailored pad shapes.

front.note: The blue left-chaise sectional retains slim arms and clean separate cushions.

rear.note: The rear panels and low back rail remain connected to the original base.

detail.note: Fine cloth grain and subtle edge highlights preserve the tailored construction without adding loose side cushions.

underside.note: Closed base modules and the original feet remain aligned beneath the chaise.

clay.note: The left chaise, narrow arms and three back pads stay legible in clay.

front.note: The blue right chaise retains its clean connected platform and narrow arms.

rear.note: Back cushions remain supported by the low rear rail and closed case.

detail.note: Restrained seams and fine upholstery grain improve surface readability while preserving the original fitted pads.

underside.note: Both platform bottoms and all visible feet remain complete.

clay.note: The right-chaise silhouette and tailored cushion divisions remain clear without materials.

front.note: The dark left-chaise sectional preserves solid track arms and connected matte upholstery.

rear.note: The rear rail, three back cushions and closed platform remain aligned.

detail.note: Track-arm edges and cushion boxing retain restrained cloth detail without coarse basket weave.

underside.note: The two base sections remain closed and supported by their original feet.

clay.note: The distinct track arms and left-chaise configuration remain readable in clay.

front.note: The right-chaise sectional retains its dark track arms and separate fitted seat pads.

rear.note: Rear cushion backs and the low support rail remain attached across the sofa.

detail.note: Clean cushion divisions and subdued surface grain preserve the original connected upholstery.

underside.note: The chaise and seat-base bottoms remain closed with aligned short feet.

clay.note: The right-chaise layout and solid track-arm construction remain clear without color.
